cases.intent: Own Equipment returns and attaches after a separate reflexive trigger.
Token creation does not require an Equipment target.
An opponent graveyard is not a legal Equipment source.
Exiling the targeted Equipment makes the reflexive ability unable to return it.
Removing the token does not prevent Equipment returning, but leaves it unattached.
Removing the source does not stop abilities already on the stack.
Creature Equipment returns but cannot attach to the token.
Noncombat damage does not trigger token creation.
Full damage prevention prevents damage and the combat-damage trigger.
The Wanderer prevents noncombat damage to its controller.
The Wanderer does not prevent combat damage.
Furnace doubles combat damage but does not double the number of damage triggers.
Furnace doubles noncombat damage without producing a combat-damage trigger.
Full prevention still prevents damage when doubling also applies.
Countering the initial trigger prevents token creation and no reflexive trigger is produced.
Countering the reflexive trigger leaves the already-created token and the Equipment in the graveyard.
Ground Seal forbids a graveyard target without stopping the untargeted initial trigger or token creation (603.3d).
Ground Seal becomes active after target selection; the reflexive ability cannot resolve against an illegal target (608.2b).
Removing Ground Seal before the initial trigger resolves permits later reflexive target selection and Equipment return.
Exiling and returning targeted Equipment to the graveyard creates a new object; the old target cannot be returned (400.7, 608.2b).
Tel-Jilad Defiance grants the token protection from artifacts. Bonesplitter returns but cannot attach (702.16d).
Ranger's Guile grants +1/+1 and hexproof; opposing spells cannot target the token, but returning Equipment attaches without targeting it.
Alexi's Cloak grants shroud; neither player's spells can target the token, but returning Equipment attaches without targeting the token.
After Equipment returns attached, Tel-Jilad Defiance grants protection from artifacts. State-based actions detach the same Equipment without removing it from the battlefield (702.16d, 704.5n).
